_README: Where these files come from. Each is a byte-identical copy of the file of the same name in nanohype/standards/ at `upstream.ref` — never hand-edit one. The digests are verified by __tests__/standards-pin.test.ts, and `npm run standards:check` re-verifies them against upstream at that same ref. `npm run standards:sync -- <sha>` moves the pin and rewrites the digests together. See README.md in this directory.
